title: Pori Theatre
geometryBasis: The native building outline establishes the 23.6-metre Hallituskatu frontage, shallow central projection and 45-metre historical depth. The modern west extension is described separately in the city inventory.
sectionBasis: The archived Qualla original shows pale ochre plaster, a light three-bay loggia facade with arched doors and upper windows, stepped parapet, iron ridge crest, hipped metal roofing and deep dentilled cornices.
limitations: Standing historic theatre and stagehouse. The modern 1974 theatre annex and interiors are outside scope.
Historic front details follow the primary photo. Rear fenestration, exact roof junctions and small ornamental patterns are representative.
